title.rendered: Labour Colony in Faridabad — Prefab Worker Housing

content.rendered:
Finding compliant, durable worker accommodation for a project in Faridabad's industrial belt is a real planning challenge. With construction active across Ballabhgarh, Surajkund, and Sector 21, demand for structured worker housing keeps rising. A labour colony in Faridabad from SAMAN Portable is a turnkey prefabricated solution — manufactured at our Jalpura, Greater Noida (201308) factory and dispatched direct to your Faridabad site. Serving India since 2009, incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019, we build worker camps on an IS 2062 mild-steel frame with insulated PUF panels for quick, repeatable installation.

Why Labour Housing Matters on Faridabad's Construction Sites

Faridabad's industrial and residential expansion has created steady demand for organised labour accommodation. Sites across Ballabhgarh's manufacturing corridor, Surajkund's tourism development, and Sector 21's mixed-use projects all need safe, hygienic housing for their workforce. Temporary makeshift shelters rarely meet the ventilation, sanitation, and safety standards modern projects are expected to maintain.

Built for Active Construction Corridors

Across Faridabad's busy construction corridors, adequate worker housing directly affects project timelines and workforce retention. A prefabricated labour colony replaces ad-hoc tin sheds with a structured, panel-built camp that can be supplied and installed wherever your project sits — Sector 21, Ballabhgarh, or Surajkund.

Designed Around Welfare Requirements

Labour welfare expectations call for housing with adequate ventilation, sanitation, and basic safety provisions. A prefabricated labour colony is built to address these from the design stage, giving site teams a structured, dignified camp instead of improvised shelters.

  • Cross-ventilation and natural lighting in every room
  • Planned floor area per worker
  • Separate toilet and bathing blocks
  • Fire-safety and emergency-exit provisions
  • Stable IS 2062 mild-steel structural frame

    • SAMAN Portable's Turnkey Worker Colonies

    SAMAN Portable manufactures prefabricated labour colonies for Faridabad construction sites at our Jalpura, Greater Noida factory and dispatches them direct to the NCR. Each worker camp is built on an IS 2062 mild-steel frame with insulated PUF panels for durability and quick installation. As an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer, we control quality from factory floor to handover.

    Durable MS-Frame Build

    Built on an IS 2062 mild-steel frame with insulated PUF panels on a prepared base for durability across Faridabad's seasons.

    Proper Ventilation

    Cross-ventilation with windows on opposite walls keeps air circulating and rooms comfortable for resident workers.

    Multi-Level Options

    G+1 configurations with MS staircases and safety railings make better use of limited site space while keeping access safe.

    Need Worker Housing for Your Faridabad Project?

    We can supply and install prefabricated labour colonies across Faridabad's construction corridors. Talk to us for a layout matched to your worker capacity.

    Call +91 62009 09435
    Send Enquiry

    16 to 32 Room Layouts with Sanitation and Power Options

    Our labour colonies are configurable so the layout matches your worker capacity and site footprint in Faridabad. The table below shows representative module sizes; final specification is confirmed per project.

    Configuration Rooms Approx. Sq Ft Occupancy Sanitation Units
    Standard Colony 16 3,200 64–80 8
    Medium Colony 24 4,800 96–120 12
    Large Colony 32 6,400 128–160 16

    Room Specifications

  • Approx. 200 sq ft per room (10×20 ft standard module)
  • 4–5 worker occupancy per room
  • Cross-ventilation with windows on opposite walls
  • Electrical points for lighting and basic appliances
  • Insulated PUF roof and walls for temperature control
  • Internal pathways between room blocks

    • Sanitation Facilities

  • Separate toilet and bathing blocks
  • Toilet units planned per worker count
  • Drainage and sewage connection points
  • Water-storage tanks sized to colony capacity
  • Easy maintenance and cleaning access

    • Best-Suited Areas: Sector 21, Ballabhgarh, Surajkund

    Our prefabricated labour colonies can be configured for the working conditions of Faridabad's key development zones.

    Sector 21

    Suited to industrial projects with higher worker density. Durable panel build and a compact footprint work well near manufacturing zones.

    Industrial Zone

    Ballabhgarh

    Suited to longer-duration housing needs in Ballabhgarh's manufacturing corridor. G+1 layouts maximise space while keeping access safe.

    Manufacturing Hub

    Surajkund

    Suited to infrastructure projects around Surajkund where a tidy, low-footprint worker camp fits the surrounding development.

    Infrastructure Development

    Speed, Strength and Safety in a Prefab Build

    Our labour colonies pair quick deployment with the durability and safety features site teams expect for worker accommodation in Faridabad.

    Construction Materials

    Each labour colony uses durable, manufacturer-controlled materials suited to Faridabad's climate while keeping rooms comfortable:

  • IS 2062 MS Frame: Mild-steel structural framework gives robust, repeatable support
  • Insulated PUF Panels: Roughly 50–60 mm foam-core panels hold comfortable temperatures year-round
  • Prepared Base: A reinforced base supports stability and longevity on site
  • Slope Roofing: Sheds water and prevents pooling through the monsoon
  • Corrosion-Resistant Skin: Galvanised exterior panels resist rust and weathering

    • Safety Features

    Every SAMAN Portable labour colony is built with practical safety provisions for a working site:

  • Fire-aware material specification
  • Multiple entry and exit points for evacuation
  • Non-slip flooring in common and sanitation areas
  • Electrical wiring with MCB protection
  • Elevated base detailing to limit water ingress
  • Structural design for wind and seismic stability

    • Ready for a Durable Labour Colony Solution?

    Our prefabricated worker camps are backed by 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. Returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation.

    Call +91 62009 09435
    Send Enquiry

    Why Prefab Worker Housing Suits Long-Term Projects

    For longer construction programmes in Faridabad, a prefabricated labour colony offers practical advantages over building temporary housing from scratch on site.

    Prefab Labour Colony

    • Faster setup than conventional on-site construction
    • Factory-built modules reduce on-site labour and downtime
    • Modular design allows expansion as the workforce grows
    • Reusable units can be relocated to the next project site
    • Insulated panels help manage running costs
    • Lower maintenance with weather-resistant materials
    • Structured camp supports welfare compliance

    Improvised On-Site Housing

    • Longer build time delays project readiness
    • Higher material wastage and rework
    • Fixed structures cannot move to a new site
    • Harder to demonstrate welfare compliance
    • Poor conditions affect workforce comfort and retention
    • More upkeep needed through the monsoon
    • Demolition and clearance costs at project end

    Suited to Government, Housing and Industrial Projects

    Our prefabricated labour colonies can be configured for different project types across Faridabad.

    Government Infrastructure

    Suited to public works such as road construction and municipal projects, with documentation support for project audits.

  • Configurable to project specifications
  • Documentation support for audits
  • Scalable to changing workforce needs

    • Residential Development

    Suited to housing projects in Surajkund and Sector 21, providing tidy worker accommodation with a compact footprint.

  • Neat layouts that suit residential surroundings
  • Compact footprint to preserve buildable area
  • Quick to install and relocate

    • Industrial Construction

    Suited to industrial sites in Ballabhgarh that need durable accommodation for longer project durations.

  • Durable panel skin for industrial environments
  • Washing and sanitation blocks sized to workforce
  • Robust frame for extended use

    • Installation Process for Quick Occupancy

    Our installation process is built to get a labour colony in Faridabad ready for occupancy without long site delays.

  • Site Assessment: Our team reviews your location in Faridabad (Sector 21, Ballabhgarh, or Surajkund) to confirm the colony configuration.
  • Base Preparation: The base is prepared to suit site conditions and colony size.
  • Module Delivery: Prefabricated units are dispatched from our Jalpura, Greater Noida factory to your site.
  • Assembly and Installation: Our team assembles the structures on the prepared base.
  • Utility Connections: Electrical, water, and sanitation connections are made and checked.
  • Safety Check: A site check confirms the camp is ready for use.
  • Handover: The site manager receives handover and basic documentation.

    • Why Choose SAMAN Portable for a Labour Colony in Faridabad

    Serving India since 2009, incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019, SAMAN Portable is a direct manufacturer of prefabricated worker housing. Our Jalpura, Greater Noida (201308) factory is the North-India dispatch source for NCR sites, so Faridabad orders are supplied factory-direct without a middle layer. We have delivered 500+ projects across India.

    Manufacturer Advantages

  • Factory-direct supply from Jalpura, Greater Noida (201308) to Faridabad
  • ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer
  • IS 2062 mild-steel frame with insulated PUF panels
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life
  • Returns accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation
  • 500+ projects delivered across India

    • Get a Quote for Your Faridabad Project

    Tell us your worker capacity and site location and we will recommend a layout and provide a quote.

    Call +91 62009 09435
    Send Enquiry

    Explore our full prefabricated labour colony range to compare configurations and finishes.

    Request a Quote

    Share your project details and our team will respond with a recommended labour colony layout and quote for your Faridabad site.

    FAQs: Labour Colony in Faridabad


    How long does it take to install a labour colony in Faridabad?

    Lead time depends on the configuration and site readiness. Because units are manufactured at our Jalpura, Greater Noida factory and dispatched direct to the NCR, a timeline is confirmed once we review your worker capacity and site conditions. Share your details for a project-specific schedule.


    What does a labour colony in Faridabad cost?

    Pricing is quote-based and depends on the number of rooms, occupancy, sanitation units, and finishes you need. Tell us your worker capacity and site location through the enquiry form or by phone, and we will send a quote for your Faridabad project.


    What are the colonies built from?

    Each labour colony is built on an IS 2062 mild-steel frame with insulated PUF panels (roughly 50–60 mm foam-core) and slope roofing on a prepared base. We are an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer.


    What warranty do you provide?

    Our labour colonies carry 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.


    Can the colony be relocated after the project?

    Yes. The modular, panel-built design means units can be disassembled and relocated to your next site, which makes them practical for multi-phase or moving construction programmes.


    What worker capacity can you supply?

    Representative layouts run from 16-room standard colonies (around 64–80 workers) to 32-room large colonies (around 128–160 workers), with supervisor and amenity blocks added as needed. Final sizing is confirmed per project.
